sentences.text: The man "was determined to extract a price from her" after their relationship soured, the judge said A Singaporean man has lost a court case to claw back hundreds of thousands of dollars that he had lavished on his ex-girlfriend while they were together.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: The S$468,000 ($369,200; £273,260) that Chander Agarwal attempted to recover from Felicia Lee was money he had "willingly" spent on her, the Singapore High Court ruled.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: Agarwal "displayed a consistent pattern of showering [Lee] with lavish gifts" even before they got together and would reassure her that he did not expect repayment, Senior Judge Lee Seiu Kin said.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: Agarwal, the CEO of a logistics company, met Felicia Lee, a former flight attendant, during a flight in 2019.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: They were in a romantic relationship from September 2022 to December 2023, the court heard.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: Their relationship fell apart after Agarwal suspected Lee of having an affair.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: Agarwal, who launched the suit in March 2024, argued that Lee had "requested various interest-free loans" from him over the course of their relationship.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: He claimed that these included S$206,000 in credit card charges, S$129,000 for overseas trips, S$17,000 to engage a fengshui master for her apartment, and S$20,000 to pay for her life insurance premiums.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: Lee argued that these were "gifts made out of love and affection" and not loans.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: In agreeing with Lee, the judge noted that Agarwal's case lacked documentary evidence - for instance, he could not produce any proof that Lee had acknowledged receipt of the loans that she had allegedly requested.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: "The evidence before me clearly shows that the claimant, smitten by the defendant, had showered her with expensive gifts during their relationship," the judge said.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: "Unfortunately, when their relationship ended on a sour note, [Agarwal] became embittered and was determined to extract a price from her." The judge also noted that Agarwal was "clearly a man of ample means who has expensive tastes", in contrast to Lee "who was not in that league".
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: In many text messages Lee had "expressed her awe when [Agarwal] suggested expensive gifts, and on occasion, her spontaneous reluctance to accept them", the judge noted.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: In concluding his written judgement, the judge cited English playwright William Congreve, who wrote in his tragedy satire The Mourning Bride: "Heav'n has no rage, like love to hatred turn'd, nor hell a fury, like a woman scorn'd." "This case shows that such emotion is not the sole province of one gender," he said.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: In early 2023, another Singaporean man had filed two lawsuits – in claims amounting to over S$3m - against a woman who rejected his romantic advances.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: K Kawshigan claimed that Nora Tan's rejection brought him emotional trauma and caused damage to his reputation.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: The Singapore courts struck out his suits.
sentences.article_title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend

sentences.text: Tan later counter-sued Kawshigan to claim back expenses she said she had incurred while defending herself from his alleged harassment.

sentences.text: The Alien Terrorist Removal Court was created in 1996, but had never heard a case before the proceedings in July.
sentences.article_title: Afghan woman deported from US in first use of 'alien terrorist' court

sentences.text: It is meant for non-US citizens facing terrorism-related charges when the evidence is confidential and related to national security.
sentences.article_title: Afghan woman deported from US in first use of 'alien terrorist' court

sentences.article_title: Afghan woman deported from US in first use of 'alien terrorist' court

sentences.text: In a statement on Friday, the justice department said she "conceded that she is an alien terrorist and waived appeal of the removal order, terminating her previous [immigration] status".
